name: Claim.MD
short_description: Medical claims clearinghouse with flat monthly plans for electronic claims, ERA remittances and eligibility checks; used behind TherapyNotes and Jane.
long_description: Claim.MD is a web-based clearinghouse: you (or your EHR) send claims in 837P format, it validates and routes them to payers, and returns remittances (ERA/835) and eligibility responses. Plans are flat monthly: Basic $30/month pay-as-you-go for low volume, Small Volume $60/month including 100 claims, 100 ERAs and 100 eligibility checks, and Unlimited $120/month with unlimited claims and ERAs plus 1,000 eligibility checks. TherapyNotes, Jane and Healthie connect to it. It handles submission and responses; denial follow-up is still your work.
one_liner: Predictable flat-rate claim submission for practices that do their own billing.
best_for: Self-billing practices that want a fixed monthly cost rather than per-claim fees
Practices on Jane, Healthie or another EHR with a direct Claim.MD connection
Prescribers and therapists who want ERA files for automatic payment posting
Growing practices: Unlimited ($120/month) covers any claim volume
not_for: Clinicians who want someone else to chase denials and payers
Very-low-volume billers, for whom Office Ally's free participating-payer claims may cost less

notes.insurance-billing: A flat-rate clearinghouse: $60/month covers 100 claims, ERAs and eligibility checks; $120 is unlimited claims and ERAs.
notes.group-practice: Unlimited claims and ERAs at $120/month keeps costs flat as a group's claim volume grows.

seo.title: Claim.MD: $120/Month Unlimited Claims Clearinghouse
seo.meta_description: Claim.MD offers unlimited claims at $120/month flat rate. Affordable clearinghouse for mental health practices with 4,000+ payer connections.

faqs.a: Claim.MD has three plans (checked October 2026): Basic at $30/month plus $0.30 per claim; Small Volume at $60/month including 100 claims, ERAs and eligibility checks, then $0.50 each; and Unlimited at $120/month for unlimited claims and ERAs with 1,000 eligibility checks. There is no setup fee. Paper claims and attachments cost extra. Confirm current rates on claim.md/pricing.

faqs.q: Does Claim.MD work with my mental health EHR?
faqs.a: Claim.MD integrates with most practice management systems and EHRs through standard ANSI X12 EDI connections. Mental health EHRs like SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, and others can typically send claims through Claim.MD. Check with your EHR vendor for specific integration instructions.

faqs.q: How many payers does Claim.MD connect to?
faqs.a: Claim.MD connects to over 4,000 payers including all major commercial insurers, Medicare, and Medicaid programs. They handle professional (837P), institutional (837I), and dental (837D) claim types.

faqs.q: Is Claim.MD good for therapy practices?
faqs.a: It suits therapy practices that bill insurance themselves and want a plain clearinghouse. Low-volume practices can start on the $30/month Basic plan; at roughly 300 or more claims a month the $120 Unlimited plan usually costs less than paying per claim.
